content.instructions: “gern” after the verb says you like doing something. “nicht gern” says you do not. For a preference use “lieber”, and for the thing you like most use “am liebsten”. The three words come after the verb, never in front of it.
text:
Likes and preferences
MeaningListenGerman
I like itIch schwimme gern.
I do not like itIch spiele nicht gern Fußball.
I prefer itIch lese lieber.
I like it bestIch tanze am liebsten.
Ich koche gern. Ich lese lieber. Am liebsten gehe ich wandern.
